epics.title: Prepare the workshop
epics.objective: Give the team a dependable repair queue and working schedule.

epics.title: Return completed work
epics.objective: Make every customer handoff traceable to completed repair work.

items.title: Create the repair queue
items.story: As a service coordinator, I can place accepted jobs in a repair queue so that technicians know what can start.
acceptance_criteria: Accepted jobs appear in a readable repair queue.

items.title: Publish the workshop schedule
items.story: As a technician, I can see the workshop schedule so that I can prepare for assigned repairs.
acceptance_criteria: The schedule shows each assigned repair job.

items.title: Prepare the customer handoff
items.story: As a service coordinator, I can prepare a customer handoff after repair work finishes so that incomplete jobs are never returned.
acceptance_criteria: The handoff remains blocked until the repair queue story is complete.
